command: npm test && npm run demo; Python Draft 2020-12 schema self-validation and demo Unit/Graph validation

tests.detail: Three DIS schemas passed Draft 2020-12 schema validation.
Recognized player reached READY through the declared path.
Evidence was retained in the terminal outcome.
Private procedure was not reclassified as a Tool.
Initial edge model requires upstream output pass-through.
Missing schemaRef is accepted as an arbitrary non-empty string.

findings.description: One Edge combines control routing and data mapping, preventing independent data/evidence dependencies.
findings.resolution: Replace with typed control, data and evidence edges; prohibit implicit output pass-through.

findings.description: Schema references are strings only and are not resolved as package resource dependencies.
findings.resolution: Require safe package-relative references and exact build-time resource closure/digest validation.
